description:
Rejects a pending remediation.

Only remediations with state PENDING_APPROVAL can be rejected.

On REJECT: state changes to CANCELLED.
The reviewed_by, review_time, and review_comment fields are populated
on the remediation after rejection.

Remediation.description:
Remediation represents a node remediation request for an instance.
An instance can have multiple remediations over time (e.g., failed attempts followed by retries).

active_health_check_run_id.description: Active health check run ID (UUID) that triggered this remediation.

error_message.description: Error message if the remediation failed.

instance_name.description: Display name of the targeted instance.

linked_alerts.description: Passive health check alerts linked to this remediation, including resolved alerts.

mode.description:
Remediation mode specifies how the remediation should be performed.

- `REMEDIATION_MODE_VM_ONLY`: Deletes the VM and provisions a new one on any available host.
- `REMEDIATION_MODE_HOST_AWARE`: Cordons the host, deletes the VM, and provisions a new one on a different host.
- `REMEDIATION_MODE_EVICT_WITHOUT_REPLACEMENT`: Evicts the VM without provisioning a replacement.
- `REMEDIATION_MODE_REBOOT_VM`: Reboots the VM in place.
- `REMEDIATION_MODE_HOST_POWER_CYCLE`: Cordons and power-cycles the bare-metal host while preserving host and node identity.

passive_health_check_event_id.description: Passive health check event ID that triggered this remediation.

state.description:
RemediationState represents the lifecycle state of a remediation.

- `PENDING_APPROVAL`: Awaiting approval before processing can begin.
- `PENDING`: Approved and queued for processing.
- `RUNNING`: Actively being processed.
- `SUCCEEDED`: Successfully completed.
- `FAILED`: Failed with an error.
- `CANCELLED`: Cancelled by user or system.
- `AUTO_RESOLVED`: The underlying issue was automatically resolved before processing.
- `QUARANTINING`: Cordoning or preparing the host before remediation.
- `QUARANTINED`: Host has been cordoned or isolated for remediation.

trigger.description:
RemediationTrigger specifies how the remediation was triggered.

- `REMEDIATION_TRIGGER_MANUAL`: A user-initiated remediation (either via web UI or API call).
- `REMEDIATION_TRIGGER_AUTOMATED`: A system-initiated remediation that requires approval.

update_time.description: When the remediation was last updated.

PassiveHealthCheckAlert.description: Passive health check alert returned by the health check API.

annotation.description: Typed annotation content parsed from the legacy annotations bag.

annotations.description: Legacy Alertmanager annotations as key-value strings.

cluster_id.description: Cluster UUID the alert was raised against.

instance_id.description: Resolved instance UUID. Empty until the alert is joined to an instance.

node_remediation_intent_id.description: Remediation intent UUID attached to this alert, if any.

passive_health_check_alert_id.description: Primary key UUID for the passive health check alert.

resolved_at.description: Time when the underlying alert resolved. Empty while the alert is firing.

severity.description: Canonical severity tier for the alert.

started_at.description: Time when the underlying alert first fired.

target_vm.description: VM name extracted from the Alertmanager labels.

PHCAnnotation.description: Typed content parsed from passive health check alert annotations.

slurm_node_unavailable.description: Slurm node details when the alert was caused by unavailable Slurm nodes.

summary_line.description: Per-firing summary line parsed from the evidence annotation.

title.description: Alert title from the Alertmanager summary annotation.

xid.description: Xid-specific details when the alert was caused by NVIDIA Xid errors.

SlurmNodeUnavailableDetail.description: Details for a Slurm node unavailable passive health check alert.

reason.description: Drain reason reported for the unavailable Slurm node.

XidDetail.description: Details for a DmesgXidError passive health check alert.

events.description: Xid events observed during the alert window.

XidEvent.description: One NVIDIA Xid code observed during the alert window.

count.description: Number of times this Xid code appeared in the alert window.

mnemonic.description: Driver mnemonic for the Xid code when metadata is available.
